lessons.goal: 以新版優先和不變事項整合兩份通知。

questions.evidence: NEW NOTICE: The fair moves to the covered hall because the courtyard entrance is being repaired. The event date and opening hours stay the same. Stall names are now due Tuesday noon. Food closes at three thirty, and all equipment must be packed by four.

OLD POSTER: Friday's club fair is in the courtyard from one to four. Stall names are due Wednesday noon. Each club gets two tables. Food can be sold until four, and clubs may bring a small powered display if the organizer has approved it.

NEW NOTICE: The fair moves to the covered hall because the courtyard entrance is being repaired. The event date and opening hours stay the same. Stall names are now due Tuesday noon. Food closes at three thirty, and all equipment must be packed by four.

ORGANIZER MESSAGE: The new notice replaces conflicting details on the poster. Existing approvals for powered displays remain valid, but clubs must request an east-wall outlet before Tuesday noon. Table allocation is unchanged. Only the organizer may move a club's assigned position.

A club that already has display approval reads both texts. Its leader submits the stall name and outlet request before the new deadline. The group plans thirty minutes for cleanup after food sales end and checks its assigned hall position rather than assuming the old courtyard layout still applies.
